note: Measured values of the test machine. Runs and evaluation happen on this machine.

host.cpu: Apple M3 Max, 10 performance + 4 efficiency cores
host.gpu: Apple M3 Max, 30 GPU cores, unified memory

graphics_runtime.opengl: OpenGL.framework, OpenGL 4.1 core profile (deprecated by Apple, still shipped)
graphics_runtime.windowing: Cocoa / AppKit (WindowServer). No X11, no Wayland, no SDL, no GLFW

display.actual: 3440 x 1440 (UWQHD - Ultra-Wide Quad HD); 2560 x 1440 (QHD/WQHD - Wide Quad High Definition)

native_executables.signing: Apple Silicon requires a code signature; ad-hoc (codesign -s -) is enough for local runs. The arm64 linker signs ad-hoc by default.

build_tools.other: codesign, otool, lipo, strip, xxd (system tools)
build_tools.package_managers: Homebrew >=4.3.0 is installed, but the build must work with the system tools and Command Line Tools above only. Do not install packages.
